about: Per-project sizes of the instance sets the leaderboard aggregation divides by: I_api (eval instances whose ground-truth test calls production methods directly), I_cov (eval instances with a coverage reference) and census_n (the project's eval instances). The kits carry the id lists (behaviour/I_api.json, behaviour/I_cov.json). Exact mode intersects those when it has them.

provenance.source: the per-project counts of the paper's tables
provenance.cross_check: the eight released kits' behaviour/I_api.json and I_cov.json have exactly these lengths
